key_decisions.decision: Retains the death image and gendered exhortation rather than generalizing it.
Keeps the dynastic promise conditional and the whole-person expression.
Retains David’s account of bloodguilt and its concrete clothing images.
Preserves the threatening wisdom charge and Sheol image.
Keeps David’s oath beside his recollection of the curse.
Does not soften David’s command or explain away its tension with the oath.
Retains the abrupt expanded accusation rather than inventing a narrated conspiracy.
Retains house as dynastic imagery and the immediate death sentence.
Preserves the stated reasons for sparing him and the today qualification.
Keeps the pinned Absalom reading and explains the parenthetical chronology.
Makes bloodguilt understandable without endorsing Solomon’s reasoning.
Preserves the comparison, claimed ignorance and distinct commands.
Retains the contrasting perpetual wishes and blood image.
Preserves the particular crossing and blood-responsibility formula.
Makes enslaved status and flight explicit; retains names and interval.
Retains the pursuit and forced return without euphemism.
